subject: Junior Engineer
paragraphs: I am writing to express my interest in the Junior Engineer role at Company Name. As a final-year Computer Science and Engineering student, I am eager to contribute to product-focused teams that value clean implementation and steady iteration.

Through academic work and hands-on projects, I have built web applications using React, TypeScript, and REST APIs, and automated workflows using n8n and scripting. I enjoy turning requirements into practical solutions while keeping usability and performance in mind.

I value clear communication, careful testing, and steady learning, and I am excited to bring that mindset to your engineering team. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to real-world delivery and grow alongside experienced engineers.
